title: Speculate builtin callees of calls that never ran
motivation: In mandelbrot, the block that calls `bitwXor(sum, byteAcc)` never ran in the warmup, so it had no feedback. The call stayed `dyn` with symbol promises, and these promises kept the version's frame a regular `mkenv`. So the loop variables stayed in the frame, and each inner iteration did many `ld`, `st`, type checks, `unbox`es and `box`es.
solution: `SpeculateAssume` adds the assumption `f ?- F` for an `ldf f` that has no feedback in a warm version, when `F` is a function that `builtins.fir` defines and that runs no R code. The `ldf` must be used only as a `dyn` callee, and no module function may define `f` or store to it. `ResolveDynamicCallee` then makes the call static, the frame becomes `mkenv~`, and promotion runs. `GlobalModules.isDefinedBuiltin` separates the defined builtins from the FUNTAB entries without a definition. `GlobalModules.runsNoRCode` admits only builtins that call no method, condition handler or `eval`, because no feedback recorded what such code would do, e.g. a `print` method that writes to `parent.frame()`.

files.repo-map.md: Adds entries for the examples `cold_print_method_writes_caller.R` and `cold_shadowed_builtin_guard.R`.
files.server/src/main/java/org/prlprg/fir/Glob: Adds `isDefinedBuiltin`, which tells a function that `builtins.fir` defines from a FUNTAB entry without a definition, and `runsNoRCode`, which admits only the listed builtins that run no R code.
files.server/src/main/java/org/prlprg/fir/opt/: Adds `neverRunBuiltinCallee`, which assumes the builtin for a never-run `ldf` used only as a `dyn` callee in a warm version, if the builtin runs no R code.
files.server/src/test/java/org/prlprg/fir/opt/: Tests the new speculation, and that base closures, FUNTAB stubs and context readers are not speculated.
files.server/src/test/resources/org/prlprg/exa: New example: a cold `print` call dispatches to a method that writes to its caller's frame.
New example: the user shadows a cold `bitwXor` after the warmup, so the assumption that it is the builtin must stay checked.
